m: अ-सेचन mfn. (also आ-सेच्˚, q.v.) charming, lovely, L.
a: असेचन, --नक — a. That on which one cannot look enough, charming, lovely; नयनयुगासेचनकं मानसवृत्त्यापि दुष्प्रापम् S. D.

s: tri, (na sicyate mano yasmin । na + sic + lyuw । saMjYAyAM kan .) yasya darSanAt tfpte ranto nAsti tat । atyantapriyadarSanaM । ityamaraH । yAhAke deKiyA tfptira Seza nA haya emana vastu । (“nayanayugAsecanakaM mAnasavfttyApi duzprApaM” । iti sAhityadarpaRe ॥)

m: अ-सेचनक-दर्शन mfn. lovely to see, Divyāv.
अ-सेन्य (4) mfn. not striking or wounding, not hurting (as words), RV. x, 108, 6.
a: असेन्य — a. Ved. 1 Not befitting an army. --2 Not striking.

m: अ-सेवा f. not following or practising, Mn. ii, 96

v: na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 1 sevABAve na॰ ba॰ । 2 sevASUnye
a: असेवन — a. 1 Not serving, disregarding. --2 Not following or practising, shunning. --नं Disregard, disobedience, inattention.
असेवित — a. Neglected; disused, abstained from. --Comp. --ईश्वर or ˚द्वार a. not waiting at the doors of the rich or great.

m: असेवितेश्वर-द्वार mfn. not waiting at the doors of the great, Hit.
अ-सेव्य mfn. not to be served or attended to, Pañcat.; Kathās.
not to be visited by (gen.), Pañcat.
not to be used or practised, not to be eaten, drunk, &c.
